"""Type codes for MongoDB servers."""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import NamedTuple


class _ServerType(NamedTuple):
    Unknown: int
    Mongos: int
    RSPrimary: int
    RSSecondary: int
    RSArbiter: int
    RSOther: int
    RSGhost: int
    Standalone: int
    LoadBalancer: int


SERVER_TYPE = _ServerType(*range(9))
